index_title: Clone-stable terminalisation and compatible MI-tuple fine-colour geometry
scope: Private B060: FOUR selected Ramsey III geometry results, twelve definitions, 76 human proof claims, four auxiliary equations and nine tasks. Actual safe finite character splits preserve pure infinite clone fibres and leave every terminal owner unary type infinite. Proper actual MI coordinates above the clone kernel give quantifier-free compatible tuples; their complete mixed semantic spectra recover ONE original fine atom, including hidden-coordinate diagonal cases and visible tuple equality. This is human proof preparation, not Lean or a Ramsey/HN/EPPA certificate. A separately scoped auxiliary proof establishes all-finite-base owner algebraicity preservation and the original-F-MI one-coordinate branch, with no ancestry into any of the four selected exports.
scope_explanation: statement and proof. Original AP is upgraded only by the actual pure-clone source; terminalisation is the specific maximal-character marked age, not arbitrary unary labels. FULL represented clone kernels and STRONG diversity products are separate. No hidden cells, hidden SAP, readout or expansion property is proved here.

assumptions.name: Original countably infinite homogeneous AP+HOM CCO source
assumptions.statement: Q is countably infinite, transitive and homogeneous in a finite complete symmetric binary language with actual occurring diversity pair orbitals. Its finite age has ordinary AP and semantic homomorphic CCO. Logical equality is separate. No old SAP, finite-exact Ramsey lift, real-hull theorem or EPPA is assumed.

assumptions.name: Specific actual maximal-character safe split construction
assumptions.statement: At every stage use the genuine maximal-exact-character construction of the imported safe split theorem: its actual connected rigid groupoid gates, full character masks, age of finite restrictions of GLOBAL character-compatible markings and homogeneous marked Fraisse limit. Gate bits are pulled back from their actual quotient classes; inactive labels are fixed. This specifies the provider construction, not an extra theorem about arbitrary unary expansions.

assumptions.name: Independent terminal typed exact-domain input for the distributivity export
assumptions.statement: For the independent lem:ramsey-typed-distributivity branch, M can be ANY actual homogeneous finite complete named-sorted relational source with SAP and semantic HOM CCO, symmetric same-sort diversity atoms and paired typed converses. Nonempty STRONG exact domains have finite positive reachable-profile presentations; products and nonempty evaluated meets have compatible endpoint sorts. This abstract branch needs neither clones nor terminal NR2.

assumptions.name: OPTIONAL original greatest finite-class equivalence is proper MI
assumptions.statement: ONLY for the auxiliary MI-side conclusion, let F be the greatest actual finite-class invariant equivalence of the ORIGINAL Q; assume F is proper meet-irreducible in its FULL invariant lattice. F need not be exact, thin or equal to the later clone kernel. All four selected source exports remain independent of this assumption.

imports.name: lem:cco-triangle-fullness
imports.statement: Actual hereditary complete binary AP+HOM CCO ages are triangle constrained, retaining actual unary/pair legality. This discharges the pure-clone source triangle premise from A01.

imports.name: thm:internal-clone-sap
imports.statement: For the actual original AP+HOM CCO triangle-constrained Q, the pure cover Q x N is homogeneous SAP+HOM CCO with old owner quotient Q and represented clone kernel K=Id union c=c;c. The c;c product here is FULL, including possible equality OUTPUT.

imports.name: thm:safe-exact-split
imports.statement: The SAME actual maximal-character split of a homogeneous SAP+HOM CCO source is a reasonable reduct-surjective finite unary expansion, with genuine homogeneous marked source, SAP and HOM CCO. Arbitrary abstract three-sector phase properties are insufficient.

imports.name: thm:finite-cover-elimination
imports.statement: Finitely many genuine safe splits give reasonable precompact unary terminalisation; every strict cover of the FULL original equivalence lattice on each current transitive sort has infinite relative index. This includes Top covers, and does not merely name a represented sublattice.

imports.name: thm:ep-ap-marked-completion
imports.statement: Finite actual old complete objects with locally legal phase bits are exactly restrictions of global character-compatible markings. Their marked homogeneous limit has unchanged old reduct; reasonableness extends the SAME old embedding. An arbitrary single global marking need not be that homogeneous limit.

imports.name: thm:foundational-rigid-character
imports.statement: The actual connected groupoid acts freely on quotient points. Each rigid graph is ONE whole original quotient orbital, its phase difference is chi(R), and a nonrigid quotient orbital has endpoints in different action orbits.

imports.name: lem:foundational-finite-phase-extension
imports.statement: On a finite set of actual quotient points, prescribed bits extend to one global character marking iff every pair in the same free action orbit has its required character difference. Independent action orbits have independent seed choices.

imports.name: prop:lattice-interface
imports.statement: On each actual homogeneous transitive symmetric named sort, FULL invariant equivalences form a finite lattice of actual orbital unions, with literal intersection as meet. No distributivity is needed for the finite MI separation argument.

imports.name: lem:typed-terminal-all-equivalences-exact
imports.statement: FULL original no-index-two implies every invariant equivalence has one RAW atomic word; Id alone may need the empty word. With original CCO the exact and FULL invariant lattices coincide. Do not infer this from the represented lattice alone.

imports.name: cor:rh-sap-infinite-exact-helly
imports.statement: In an infinite homogeneous symmetric SAP+HOM CCO source with FULL NR2, EVERY finite pairwise-intersecting family of actual nonidentity invariant-equivalence classes has nonempty common intersection. The family need not contain all MI coordinates.

imports.name: lem:typed-exact-products
imports.statement: On ANY actual homogeneous typed SAP+HOM CCO source, nonempty STRONG exact products distribute over finite exact meets with NONEMPTY evaluation; factors and products have compatible original endpoint types. Empty-list Top conventions are handled by the provider.

imports.name: lem:typed-set-pasch
imports.statement: Actual homogeneous typed SAP sources have associative STRONG composition and the Peircean laws, with logical real equality excluded from all diversity palettes.

imports.statement: On actual proper quotient sorts, complete mixed semantic spectra equal (J;a;L) restricted to old real diversity, equivalently J^circ*{a}*L^circ for nonzero exteriors. The off-diagonal named cylinder omits ONLY the diagonal of the SAME hidden sort.

imports.statement: Original relational SAP permits pinned diversity path support and gives RAW kernel saturation off the real diagonal equal to STRONG exterior products. True Id exteriors are omitted; they are never replaced by an empty diversity factor.
imports.provider_support_usage: Use the proved strict ancestor C01 ONLY to separate all positions of one nonempty RAW atomic word while pinning its already DISTINCT old endpoints. It proves positivity of J^circ from the RAW word; it introduces no new STRONG associativity assumption.

imports.statement: For an actual nonzero invariant equivalence J in an old SAP source, every nonempty old palette P contained in J^circ has J^circ*P*J^circ=J^circ. This supports the coincident-coordinate case, with no CCO/NR2 needed once P and J are given.

imports.statement: The original FULL finite commuting invariant lattice has its greatest finite-class equivalence F=Sigma(Id); actual uniform relative indices satisfy transposition/tower formulas, without exactness or distributivity.
imports.provider_support_usage: Use precisely the strict proved ancestors C01/C02 of C03: actual full equivalence commutation, finite orbital lattice and uniform class-count index transposition/tower formulas. Do not import finite-exact normalization or packet naming.

No normalized/exact-owner premises from the other source branches are used.

No thin-owner naming, normalization or EPPA conclusion is imported.

definitions.name: Pure clone and owner projection
definitions.statement: M=Q x N, pi(q,n)=q; c relates distinct points with the same owner, and K=ker(pi)=Id union c. Different-owner pair colours are the original Q atoms.

definitions.name: Clone-saturated unary type
definitions.statement: A unary type is clone-saturated when it is pi^{-1}(U) for an owner type U; all independent permutations inside each whole N-fibre preserve it.

definitions.name: Actual split gates and character points
definitions.statement: L_* is the source gate containing the finite-index lower endpoint Y; reached target gates are L_t=R^op R, with L_* R=R. Phase bits are actual gate-class bits in the same rigid character groupoid.

definitions.name: Monochromatic owner clique
definitions.statement: An infinite subset of distinct current owners with all fine pair colours the same atom a outside K. It is taken from the ACTUAL infinite parent owner type, by infinite Ramsey on its finite symmetric pair palette.

definitions.name: Fixed MI coordinate symbol list
definitions.statement: A fixed family of distinct proper FULL invariant MI equivalences J>=K_s is meet-representing if its meet is K_s. C24 proves that taking all such MI is one available choice; any meet-representing subfamily is permitted. Its list is fixed by symbols, not by choosing a representative for each point.

definitions.name: Actual representative spectrum with a diagonal clause
definitions.statement: For actual quotient vertices b in M_s/J,d in M_t/L, Spec(b,d) is the set of old diversity atoms realized by DISTINCT representatives. For b=d in the SAME quotient sort, define it by the actual equality case Spec(b,b)=J^circ.

definitions.name: Compatible MI tuple domain
definitions.statement: delta_s(b_1,...,b_r) consists of the correct fixed coordinate sort tags and c_s in Spec(b_i,b_j) for every i<j. Each such tuple is to represent ONE K_s-class.

definitions.name: Nonempty STRONG exact meet
definitions.statement: A nonempty typed diversity domain is a finite intersection of positive reachable profiles. Products use original typed distinct formal path positions and never adjoin real equality as a diversity atom.

definitions.name: Owner coordinate map
definitions.statement: eta_s(q)=([x]_J_i)_i for ANY clone x over owner q. Independence of x and injection are proved from the kernel meet, not a selected section.

definitions.name: Fine-colour or equality reconstruction
definitions.statement: For compatible tuples u,v, intersect ALL actual spectra Spec(u_i,v_j), including equality clauses. A singleton original atom a represents fine colour; singleton c_s on equal visible tuples represents VISIBLE EQUALITY.

definitions.name: Real owner algebraic closure
definitions.statement: For a finite actual owner base A in a homogeneous quotient source P, acl_P(A) is the set of owner points with finite orbit under the FULL actual Aut(P/A). Complete one-point types are actual orbits by quotient homogeneity.

definitions.name: Original finite packet restricted to one terminal sort
definitions.statement: Fbar_s is the pullback of the ORIGINAL owner equivalence F restricted to terminal clone sort s. It contains K_s and each Fbar_s-class has at most |F-class| distinct owner K_s-classes; it is not assumed originally exact.

claims.name: Original AP+CCO supplies the clone source triangle premise
claims.statement: A01 and I01 give actual triangle fullness; I02 therefore applies without adding old SAP.

claims.name: Pure cover has the represented clone kernel
claims.statement: The actual cover has homogeneous SAP+HOM CCO and K=Id union c=c;c by I02/C01; its owner quotient is the original Q. FULL c;c includes equality outputs, unlike STRONG c*c.

claims.name: Independent fibre permutations survive clone-saturated labels
claims.statement: Any finite or infinite permutation inside one N-fibre fixes its owner and all old fine colours; clone-saturated unary labels are also fixed. These independent permutations belong to the actual current automorphism group.

claims.name: Current clone kernel is invariant
claims.statement: In each current clone-saturated transitive sort, K is an invariant equivalence and each of its classes is a full infinite clone fibre.

claims.name: K is the least nonidentity invariant equivalence
claims.statement: If an invariant E contains one distinct pair in a fibre, fibre permutations give all that fibre and transitivity gives K everywhere. If xEy have different owners, transpose x with another clone xprime while fixing y; E transitivity gives xExprime and the first case applies.

claims.name: A finite-index lower endpoint cannot be real equality
claims.statement: For a proper finite-index interval Y<X, Y=Id would force X>=K by C05 and hence an infinite number of Id-classes inside every X-class, contradicting finite index. Thus Y>Id and K<=Y.

claims.name: The source split gate contains clone classes
claims.statement: The actual source gate L_* contains Y by A02, so C06 gives K<=L_*; all source gate-class bits are constant on clone fibres.

claims.name: Every reached target gate contains its clone kernel
claims.statement: For yK_t yprime and xRy, choose a fresh source clone x0 distinct from y,yprime. Since K_s<=L_* and L_*R=R, x0Ry even if the original x equals y. Transposing y,yprime while fixing x0 gives x0Ryprime. Hence y(R^op R)yprime, so K_t<=L_t. This also handles coincident source/target sorts and old owners.

claims.name: All new labels are clone-saturated
claims.statement: C07/C08 make every active pulled-back character bit constant on its entire clone fibre; inactive labels are fixed. Repeating the argument at every actual split preserves all fibre permutations.

claims.name: The homogeneous marked source is again a pure cover
claims.statement: The legal finite marked class I05 has an equivalence K with uniform old colours between its classes and infinite fibres (every finite fibre extension is legal by C09). Its homogeneous limit is thus isomorphic over its owner quotient to Qnew x N with the SAME c rule.

claims.name: The owner marked age is homogeneous and reasonable
claims.statement: Lift any finite owner partial isomorphism to arbitrary distinct actual clones in C10, extend by marked homogeneity, and project. For reasonableness lift a prescribed old owner embedding on one clone per point using I03/I05; fibre-constant marks descend. Thus the new owner age is a reasonable finite unary expansion of its parent.

claims.name: An infinite parent owner type has a looped atom outside K
claims.statement: Apply the ordinary infinite Ramsey theorem to the ACTUAL infinite complete symmetric finite-coloured owner graph in that parent unary type. An infinite monochromatic clique uses distinct owners, so its lifted fine atom a is outside K and occurs on an actual a,a,a triangle.

claims.name: A rigid looped atom has identity gate arrow
claims.statement: If the gate cylinder of a in C12 is a rigid graph R, an actual a,a,a triangle gives R squared(q)=R(q) at its first quotient point q. Invertibility gives R(q)=q; freeness of the actual groupoid action forces R to be the identity arrow, so its character is zero.

claims.name: Nonrigid looped pairs have independent action seeds
claims.statement: If that gate cylinder is not rigid, I06 puts each pair of distinct quotient points in different free-action orbits; if two quotient points coincide they impose only identity phase zero. There is therefore no forced opposite phase on any such a-pair.

claims.name: A constant desired child bit meets every finite pair test
claims.statement: On any finite part of the actual clique, assign the SAME desired active bit epsilon to all points. C13 gives zero difference on rigid pairs; C14 leaves distinct action-orbit seeds free. Coincident gate points also receive one consistent bit.

claims.name: The whole clique prefix is globally markable at once
claims.statement: I07 extends all C15 prescriptions simultaneously to ONE global character marking on the old source. I05 then puts the entire finite marked clique in the genuine legal marked age, with all its original complete old pairs intact.

claims.name: Every nonempty child owner type remains infinite
claims.statement: For every n and every realized child bit epsilon, C16 yields n DISTINCT owners of that child in the marked age. An induced embedding into its homogeneous marked source cannot merge owners: the pair atom a is outside K. Thus the child owner sort is infinite. Inactive children retain their parent owner type.

claims.name: Finite actual terminalisation preserves the owner product
claims.statement: Start from Q infinite; C09-C11 and C17 iterate along the finite sequence I04. All owner unary types remain infinite and the final actual source is Mdagger=Qdagger x N, with Qdagger a reasonable reduct-surjective precompact finite unary expansion of Q.

claims.name: Each terminal clone kernel is proper nonzero FULL exact
claims.statement: Each terminal owner sort is infinite by C18, so K_s<Top and c_s is nonempty. Full c_s;c_s=K_s survives unchanged inside each infinite fibre, proving exactness directly. I04 gives FULL terminal infinite-cover premises for later I09/I10 applications.

claims.name: Clone-stable terminalisation source export
claims.statement: C18/C19 prove lem:ramsey-clone-stability for the specific actual safe character construction, without asserting this for arbitrary unary labels or assuming any later Ramsey/EPPA result.

claims.name: The actual terminal invariant lattice is finite
claims.statement: I08 identifies FULL invariant equivalences on each transitive terminal clone sort with finitely many actual orbital unions; meet is literal intersection. C19 gives Id<K_s<Top.

claims.name: A finite lattice has a maximal separator above K
claims.statement: For any lattice element H>K, choose a maximal J>=K with H not<=J. It exists because K itself excludes H and the lattice is finite. This J is proper.

claims.name: Every maximal separator is meet-irreducible
claims.statement: If J=E meet F with E,F>J, maximality in C22 forces H<=E and H<=F, hence H<=J, contradiction. Thus J is proper MI.

claims.name: All proper MI elements above K meet exactly at K
claims.statement: Let T be their meet, with K<=T. If T>K, apply C22/C23 to H=T; the resulting selected MI J would satisfy T<=J and T not<=J. Therefore T=K. This uses only finite lattice separation, not distributivity.

claims.name: A meet-representing coordinate list exists and is represented
claims.statement: C24 permits choosing ANY fixed family of distinct proper MI above K whose meet is K; taking all is one default. Every such family is nonempty since K<Top. All its elements are >Id and terminal FULL NR2/I09 make them RAW exact, so they are existing actual proper V27 quotient sorts. Subsequent calculations depend only on that meet equation.

claims.name: eta is independent of the chosen clone
claims.statement: Every chosen J_i contains K. Two clones over one owner therefore have the same J_i class for every i, proving eta is a canonical tuple without a section.

claims.name: eta is injective on old owners
claims.statement: Equal eta tuples put any two representatives in every J_i; C24 puts them in K, hence they have the same owner. Different owner unary sort tags are also distinct.

claims.name: The diagonal representative spectrum is the full J diversity support
claims.statement: Every atom a inside J occurs in each actual J-class by old transitivity and invariance of J. Conversely any distinct pair of representatives in that class has atom inside J. Thus Spec(b,b)=J^circ; hidden equality is distinct from old real equality.

claims.name: Two coordinate classes meet exactly when their spectrum contains c
claims.statement: If actual J,L classes meet, one common owner has two distinct clones belonging to BOTH since K<=J,L, yielding c in Spec. Conversely a c-pair has one owner and its full K-class lies in both J,L classes, so they meet.

claims.name: The tuple formula means pairwise class compatibility
claims.statement: By C29, all c-membership tests for i<j are exactly pairwise intersection of the chosen actual J_i classes. The r=1 formula has no pair test and every actual J_1 class is inhabited.

claims.name: Compatible coordinates have exactly one common owner
claims.statement: Apply I10 to the finite nonidentity actual J_i classes using the actual terminal homogeneous SAP+HOM CCO source from C18/C19 and FULL NR2 from I04. Their common intersection is nonempty; for a point x in it, the intersection is the class of meet_i J_i=K at x by C24. Thus there is precisely one owner.

claims.name: The compatible domain is quantifier-free
claims.statement: Each c-membership test is a finite disjunction of the named complete mixed cylinder orbitals whose spectra contain c, with the actual same-hidden-sort equality clause C28 when applicable. Sort tags are finite unary conditions. No representative or point-dependent choice enters the formula.

claims.name: Orphan coordinates use the same actual formula
claims.statement: Every completed finite hidden object is induced in actual coordinate data, even if it lacks real witnesses or common-cell vertices. Realize the whole unordered finite object once; C29-C32 then apply to its actual coordinates simultaneously. Closure may omit the common owner, which is interpreted as a tuple rather than added to the hidden carrier.

claims.statement: C26/C27 and C30-C33 prove lem:ramsey-mi-domain: eta identifies original owners exactly with compatible tuples in the actual coordinate universe, and the same finite formula defines valid tuples in any actual completed finite hidden member.

claims.name: Nonempty diversity meet of the chosen kernels is the clone atom
claims.statement: Removing the common old real diagonal from the literal meet C24 gives meet_i J_i^circ=K^circ={c_s}. The coordinate list is nonempty by C25, and c_s is realized; no empty-palette or empty-list identity convention is used.

claims.name: Every chosen J diversity support has a positive exact presentation
claims.statement: I09 gives a RAW atomic word for J>Id; deleting genuine Id letters leaves a nonempty word, since J contains the occurring c_s pair. Apply I14 strict C01 support to its distinct endpoint realizations: its STRONG profile is exactly J^circ. Thus each selected support is a positive reachable profile; singleton fine atoms are positive length-one profiles.

claims.name: The abstract distributivity source is the correct actual one
claims.statement: Under independent A03, the hypotheses of I11 and I12 are exactly actual homogeneous named typed SAP+HOM CCO, nonempty strong exact factors and compatible endpoint tags. They require no primitivity, NR2, clones, safe splitting or hidden quotient SAP.

claims.statement: Instantiate I11 at the A03 source and the supplied positive exact presentations: (meet_i P_i)*(meet_j Q_j)=meet_{i,j}(P_i*Q_j), with every meet evaluation stipulated nonempty. Real equality is never part of a strong palette.

claims.statement: I11 closes nonempty exact factors under typed strong convolution. I12 gives associativity for multiple factors. Hence an application of C38 can be iterated whenever the actual evaluated factors/meets are nonempty; word concatenation retains a positive reachable-profile presentation.

claims.name: The terminal clone application discharges the abstract source premises
claims.statement: C18/C19 supply an actual homogeneous SAP+HOM CCO terminal source; C36 supplies J^circ and singleton positive exact presentations, and C35 gives the nonempty kernel meet. Thus C38/C39 can be newly instantiated on this source, rather than identifying original Q AP multiplication with STRONG clone multiplication.

claims.name: Typed nonempty meet-product distributivity source export
claims.statement: C38/C39 prove the independently parameterized lem:ramsey-typed-distributivity under A03. C40 records its separate actual terminal clone application for the singleton argument.

claims.name: Distinct owners admit distinct clone representatives
claims.statement: Given q,r with q!=r, any lifted representatives x,y are distinct and have their literal old fine atom a. For q=r choose two distinct clones; their atom is c_s. This permits the same representative-spectrum calculation without inserting Id into any path.

claims.name: Distinct-coordinate spectra are the actual strong kernel cylinders
claims.statement: For eta_s(q)_i and eta_t(r)_j distinct as hidden vertices, I13 and I14 identify their spectrum with J_si^circ*{a}*J_tj^circ. Both exterior kernels are nonzero. It is ONE complete actual cylinder, not an arbitrary union of output orbitals.

claims.name: Coincident hidden coordinates satisfy the same formula
claims.statement: If the two coordinates are equal in one hidden quotient sort, their kernels are the SAME J and their distinct old representatives have a inside J^circ. I15 gives J^circ*{a}*J^circ=J^circ, exactly Spec(b,b) by C28. This covers both different owners sharing that coordinate and equal visible owners.

claims.name: Every coordinate-pair spectrum has one uniform actual formula
claims.statement: C43 and C44 exhaust distinct versus equal hidden endpoints, yielding Spec(eta_s(q)_i,eta_t(r)_j)=J_si^circ*{a}*J_tj^circ for ALL i,j, with distinct real representatives as in C42.

claims.name: Intersecting all spectra leaves c_s*a*c_t
claims.statement: Use C40/I11 twice with the actual nonempty exact kernel families, the singleton {a}, and exact intermediate products; C45 contains a in every spectrum, ensuring the relevant final meet is nonempty. Associativity I12 gives meet_{i,j} Spec=(meet_i J_si^circ)*{a}*(meet_j J_tj^circ)={c_s}*{a}*{c_t}.

claims.name: Pure clone endpoint shifts fix the literal atom
claims.statement: Any c_s,a,c_t path keeps both exterior owners fixed, so its old output atom is a. Conversely choose fresh clones of the original two endpoint owners to realize all interior positions distinctly while preserving a. For a=c_s choose four distinct clones in one fibre. Hence {c_s}*{a}*{c_t}={a}.

claims.name: Distinct visible owners have singleton original fine colour
claims.statement: For q!=r the atom a in C42 is an original old Qdagger typed fine atom, not c. C46/C47 give exactly the singleton {a} for the intersection of all coordinate spectra.

claims.name: Equal visible tuples return exactly the clone marker
claims.statement: For one owner q, use a=c_s and two distinct clones in C42. C46/C47 yield the singleton {c_s}. C27 shows equal tuples mean the same owner; thus the returned c_s is interpreted as VISIBLE EQUALITY, not as a visible diversity edge or logical real Id in a product.

claims.name: Original fine relations are quantifier-free on valid tuples
claims.statement: For each old atom a, require visible tuple inequality plus a in every finite spectrum; C48 says this selects exactly old a. Spectrum memberships are finite disjunctions of complete cylinder/equality cases as C32. Same-source tuples are equal iff all coordinate entries agree; different owner sort tags cannot denote one owner.

claims.name: All compatible tuples coexist in one actual owner source
claims.statement: For ANY actual completed finite hidden D, realize its entire unordered structure once. C33 gives one actual owner per valid tuple, and C48-C50 fix every pair fine colour independently of the chosen realization. Thus reconstructing the finite visible object has no additional simultaneous-cell existence obligation.

claims.name: Singleton fine-colour source export
claims.statement: C48-C51 prove lem:ramsey-singleton-recovery, including hidden-coordinate diagonal cases, visible equality c_s and quantifier-free old fine-colour recovery. No Ramsey theorem or free ordering of deleted clone-real vertices is an input.

claims.name: Bare equivalence coordinates need not recover fine colours
claims.statement: In a homogeneous pure owner set with two possible additional fine pair colours (for example a two-coloured generic complete graph), the bare equality/Top equivalence reduct forgets those colours. More generally deleting complete mixed cylinders loses information even if a family of class intersections is recognized. The positive singleton proof uses the full mixed spectra and exact products.

claims.name: FULL c;c is not the strong product c*c
claims.statement: Inside one infinite clone fibre, FULL c;c contains equal endpoint pairs and equals K, whereas its STRONG diversity output is only {c}. Replacing K by Id as a strong unit or inserting equality among diversity atoms invalidates the typed calculation.

claims.name: Arbitrary unary labels can destroy owner infinitude
claims.statement: On a pure infinite owner set, label exactly one owner by a new predicate and pull it back to clones. It is clone-saturated but its marked owner sort is finite. Thus C09 alone does not prove C17: the actual free-character pair constraints and global extension C13-C16 are essential.

claims.name: Finite windows are diagnostics rather than unbounded certification
claims.statement: Bounded coloured coordinate clone windows check actual spectra, whole represented/strong products, finite MI meets, tuple domains and reconstruction, and finite character constraints. They prove no infinite SAP/CCO theorem, generic marked-age theorem, HN bridge or Lean certification.

claims.name: No empty coordinate family is used in the owner reconstruction
claims.statement: C19 has K<Top and C25 has at least one proper MI above K. Therefore every visible sort has r_s>=1; an empty tuple family or empty intersection convention cannot accidentally identify infinitely many owners or produce a false clone unit.

claims.name: Nonalgebraic current parent owner types are infinite actual orbits
claims.statement: For any finite owner base A with all old unary labels, current quotient homogeneity C11 identifies each realized complete parent one-point type p outside acl_P(A) with an infinite Aut(P/A)-orbit X of distinct owners. Every actual spoke to A is fixed by that type.

claims.statement: Apply the explicit nested-infinite-tail/pigeonhole construction of N03 to X from C58. It yields an actual infinite a-clique outside A, with a outside K, and every point retains the SAME complete old one-point type over A.

claims.name: A realized child type can be copied over the full marked base
claims.statement: Take a realized complete child type pplus over marked A, lying above the nonalgebraic p. Keep all marks on A, and give each of n actual clique points C59 the same new bit epsilon of pplus. Every anchor spoke has its actual p colour and the already legal pplus endpoint bits; all new-new pairs have zero-phase looped a by C13/C14. Thus ALL actual finite pair masks are simultaneously legal.

claims.name: Simultaneous phase extension realizes arbitrarily many copies over A
claims.statement: I05/I07 extend the entire actual finite diagram C60 to one global marking; embed its marked finite restriction into the genuine homogeneous marked source and align its FULL marked A by an automorphism. The n new owners remain distinct by their nonclone pair atom a, and have exactly pplus over A.

claims.name: One actual safe split preserves real owner algebraic closure
claims.statement: A nonalgebraic parent orbit remains infinite by C61, for EVERY realized child type over A. Conversely an algebraic parent point stays algebraic because the expanded pointwise stabilizer is a subgroup of the parent stabilizer. Therefore acl_Pplus(A)=acl_P(A) for EVERY finite owner A, with all its actual labels, in the unchanged old reduct.

claims.name: Finite safe terminalisation preserves all finite-base owner closure
claims.statement: Iterate C62 along the finite actual split sequence C18/I04. Quotient homogeneity and reasonableness hold at each step by C11, so acl_Qdagger(A)=acl_Q(A) for EVERY finite actual owner A, including empty A. This general preservation lemma requires no F-MI assumption.

claims.name: Original proper MI F has a least strict coarsening
claims.statement: Under optional A04, I16 gives the finite FULL invariant lattice, actual commuting relations and greatest finite-class F. Proper MI in a finite lattice has exactly one cover D; every element >F contains D, so D is its least strict coarsening.

claims.name: There is one minimal infinite original direction
